# A page from an example journal

Yesterday's run left the index half built, and what went wrong went into the
log rather than into a note. I cannot check my own work, so the second read
went to someone else.

On 2026-08-14 I cannot check the Windows runner from here, and the fix went in
with that measurement written beside it rather than as a standing property.

I rush the last mile. It is the worst habit I have, and the reason the
checklist exists at all.
